title: dedicated-autoscaler: improve burst controls, throughput guarantees, and utilization reporting
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: customers on Dedicated fleets need smoother burst behavior and clearer utilization signals to maintain throughput guarantees while avoiding noisy autoscaler activity. This PR introduces a token-bucket based burst controller, adds a throughput-guarantee enforcement path, and extends utilization reporting to include per-fleet token bucket state and queueing latency breakdowns. The change touches the autoscaler, scheduler routing, metrics collection, and the dedicated console reporting pipeline. Checklist: - Implement token-bucket burst controller and smoothing (autoscaler/service) - Add throughput guarantee enforcement and fallback routing - Emit bucket and queue metrics to the observability pipeline - Add end-to-end tests + unit coverage - Update docs and release notes - Run perf experiments and tune defaults See linked Linear items for acceptance criteria and perf targets.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial token-bucket impl; integrate burst control into autoscaler; add throughput-guarantee enforcement; emit observability metrics; test and docs updates.
review_comments: Marco: asked for clearer invariants around token refill and edge cases during sustained overload; requested additional unit tests for bucket underflow. Samir: requested that throughput-guarantee enforcement be configurable per-fleet and suggested fallback to lower-cost model variants rather than rejecting requests. Lina: requested additional observability labels (fleet_id, priority) and a short perf summary. Author replies: clarified refill rate calculation, added unit tests for underflow and boundary cases, made enforcement toggles per-fleet with config flags, implemented fallback routing to compatible low-cost variants and added requested labels. Final approval after CI green and perf numbers within target.
ci_checks: CI: unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (flaky initially - queueing test fixed), lint (pass), perf-canary (pass), e2e (pass). One rerun of integration-tests after test harness fix.
merge_details: Merge: squash and merge. Commit message condensed to highlight token-bucket burst controller, throughput guarantees, and utilization reporting. Changelog entry added.
release_notes: Improved Dedicated autoscaler burst handling with token-bucket smoothing; added throughput-guarantee enforcement and per-fleet token/queue utilization metrics exposed in the console. Defaults tuned to reduce noisy scaling during short spikes.
